label: Isset Check
description: Checks whether a PHP variable or nested value exists and is not null.

properties.name: variable_path
properties.label: Variable path
properties.help: Use a PHP variable name without the dollar sign. Dot notation addresses nested values, for example user.profile.email.

properties.name: access_mode
properties.label: Nested access
properties.help: Array generates ['key'] access. Object generates ->property access.
